description: Golden vectors for AppRequest v2 (pkt_t=0x04, ver=0x02), the request/response exchange on an app_traffic TCP connection. 44 bytes on wire. See contracts/packets/app_request.md. Layout: pkt_t(1) + ver(1) + activity(1) + reserved(1) + flow_id(4) + object_id(8) + up_bytes(8) + down_bytes(8) + delay_ms(4) + rate_bps(4) + chunk_bytes(4).

cases.name: llm_call_stream
cases.notes: activity 9 = llm_call: a 40 kB context goes up; after 900 ms (time to first token) 12 kB of SSE events come back, 140 B every 140*8/30000 s (30 kbit/s). object_id = agent 0, episode 5, object 2.

cases.name: photo_upload_ack
cases.notes: down_bytes 0: the server echoes the 44-byte header once the 2.5 MB arrived (v1 upload equivalent). activity 8 = photo_upload.
